positive_update: Reported corpus parse/lowering acceptance increased from 3/40 to 36/40 sources while four unevidenced/conflicting sources remain rejected.

A minimal executable counterexample showed that PR310 silently erased anonymous literal !: before the fix f(true)=True and f(false)=False; PR314 names the token and aliases the rule so Not is preserved, yielding False and True.
BOOLEAN now uses a word boundary, preventing identifiers such as false_alarm_rate from being split at false.
Each syntax increment reportedly retained baseline parse structure and a sampled decide_effect differential gate with zero mismatches.
critical_qualification: 36/40 is source parse/AST-lowering coverage, not semantic-analysis or executable evaluator coverage.

The unchanged evaluator imports/handles only Literal, Path, Not, BoolOp, Compare, Call and the old statement set, while the new syntax blob can emit arithmetic, collections, lambdas, indexing, method chains, with-update, broadcast, for, match, pass, if-else and multiple new declaration nodes; unsupported executed nodes fail closed.
The 200576-request gate never exercised ! because frank_effects.clay spells the relevant condition as == false. Request-count coverage did not imply construct coverage.
No GitHub combined-status context or separately inspectable target-host receipt was observed at the exact PR314 head.
evidence_families.independence_boundary: Coordinating-session reruns and delegated models share implementation, corpus and project lineage. Classify as same-lineage re-verification, not independent replication.

l0.design: 30 seeds, 60 cycles, four actions, reward mapping switch at cycle 30.
l0.result: TRUTHFUL mean reward 0.601 versus 0.275 for SHUFFLED, NO_REENTRY and TRUTHFUL_SABOTAGED; truthful won 29/30 with one tie and zero inversions; exact sign p approximately 2.9e-8.
preserved_limits: All three broken arms were bitwise identical because a fixed first-action fallback collapsed the intended lesions.
recovery_cycles_to_0.8 is invalid because its rolling window includes pre-switch observations; the report instead notes 0.724 to 0.486.
Target-host replay used the same code and seeds and was reported bit-identical; it is cross-host reproduction, not an independent experiment.

l1_l2.l1_null: Forced exploration plus a forgiving window did not distinguish broken arms because fixed-priority A0 remained permissive without own-bucket samples; preserved as N-LOOPCORE-L1-001.
l1_l2.l2_result: TRUTHFUL 0.581 plus/minus 0.050; NO_REENTRY 0.296 plus/minus 0.045; TRUTHFUL_SABOTAGED 0.296 plus/minus 0.045 and exactly equal to NO_REENTRY; SHUFFLED 0.247 plus/minus 0.175. NO_REENTRY minus SHUFFLED was 4.9 percentage points; two-sided exact sign p 0.0161248.
l1_l2.interpretation: Structurally invalid or hash-broken reentry collapsed to no information, while structurally acceptable but action-misattributed feedback was behaviorally worse and high-variance.

critical_qualification: The synthetic binding repurposes real host intrinsic names for unrelated experiment predicates, so contract names do not attest bound semantics; this is sandbox evidence only.

Raw code/results are reported in session scratch and VPS temporary storage rather than durable canonical blobs. The canonical reports/events preserve summaries, not independently inspectable raw run lineage.
The L0 event still says sandbox-only while a later report addendum claims target reexecution, creating a report/event state mismatch.
Cryptographic/hash validity establishes byte binding, not the truth of action/outcome attribution. A same-authority producer can recompute a valid hash over wrong semantics.
evidence_families.scope_boundary: No live FRANK, training, consciousness, emergence, real GWT competition, Hyperposition, ClayGraph or UnifiedDB learning claim follows.

sources.claim: Lark filters unnamed literals by default and conditionally inlines ? rules when one child remains after filtering; named terminals are retained.
keep_all_tokens defaults false and controls automatic punctuation-token removal.

evidence_families.fusion: The documented tree-shaping rules directly predict the PR310 silent-negation mechanism; they support the root-cause explanation but do not independently execute the project patch.

concepts.hypothesis: Language coverage must be reported per construct and source as a vector <lexed, parsed, AST-preserved, analyzed, admitted, executed, differentially checked, mutation-killed>; a scalar percentage must not cross stage boundaries.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Parse/AST corpus coverage is a useful scalar if every newly representable node fails closed until later stages support it.
concepts.current_evidence: PR314 raises parse/lowering acceptance to 36/40 while evaluator.py remains the PR310 blob and rejects many newly emitted node classes.
decisive_test: Generate at least one positive and one semantic mutant for every grammar alternative and AST class.
Record the highest completed stage for each cell and publish numerator/denominator per stage.
Attempt admission/execution of every newly lowered node; unsupported nodes must be explicit expected refusals, never counted as executable coverage.
Block promotion whenever a user-facing scalar is not stage-qualified.

concepts.hypothesis: Every semantics-bearing operator token must produce exactly one typed semantic node or a declared, tested desugaring receipt; silent erasure is a correctness failure even when corpus request differentials pass.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Token conservation is too syntactic because a correct frontend may normalize or desugar operators without preserving a one-to-one node.
concepts.synthesis: Permit many-to-one or zero-node lowering only through an explicit desugaring map whose before/after semantics are mutation-tested.
decisive_test: Operator-mutate !, not, unary -, and/or, in, comparisons, with-update and broadcast on minimal executable witnesses.
Compare tokens, parse trees, lowered AST and behavior; require each mutation to change a declared observable or be proven equivalent.
Add the historical anonymous-! grammar as a must-fail regression fixture.

concepts.hypothesis: A reentry receipt is safe for learning only when syntactic/hash validity, origin authority, subject/action attribution, temporal alignment, semantic truth and consumer use are separately verified; hash validity alone can authenticate misinformation.
concepts.counterhypothesis: If the sole receipt signer is a trusted control plane and its schema derives action/outcome attribution from protected state, valid provenance is sufficient.
concepts.current_evidence: In L2, malformed/hash-broken reentry equaled NO_REENTRY, but SHUFFLED feedback retained enough structure to pass and reduced reward by 4.9 points with high variance.
decisive_test: Using the currently authorized signing path, recompute structurally valid receipts over deliberately wrong action/outcome attribution.
Hold seeds, actions and availability constant; compare truthful, invalid-hash, valid-misattributed and no-reentry arms.
Require attribution lookup against protected selected-action/outcome state before learning admission.
If valid-misattributed receipts are accepted and degrade behavior, falsify provenance-validity-equals-truth.

concepts.hypothesis: Later execution evidence must create an immutable new event or explicit supersession edge; a mutable report addendum must not silently upgrade an earlier sandbox-only event.
concepts.counterhypothesis: A timestamped, hash-bound report addendum is sufficient when the original event remains historically correct.
decisive_test: Graph-check every report addendum against linked event status, target, artifact hashes and execution identity.
Require a new REEXECUTION event carrying exact code/result hashes and a supersedes edge to the sandbox event.
Treat unmatched addenda as author-reported evidence, not canonical target execution closure.

Raw loop run artifacts are not durable canonical repo objects.
